verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents an Exports API. A developer creates an export by type and date range, and the types include CUSTOMER, SCREENING_AND_MONITORING_CASES and TRANSACTION_MONITORING_CASES_AND_ALERTS. Customers can be looked up by an external identifier for reconciliation, and a case audit-trail endpoint returns the history behind case decisions. missing for 10: explicit documentation that export files carry stable customer/case/alert IDs, confirmation that screening alerts and case decisions are included in exports, independent or hands-on corroboration, and relief from the 5-second download-URL TTL.
